note: Season boundary, day before: 31 Jul is still the season named for this year.
Season boundary, first day: 1 Aug rolls the season year, so the group moves up while the age does not.
1 Jan birthday read mid-season. Reading the DOB via a UTC Date rolls this to 31 Dec 2014 and answers U10.
1 Jan birthday ON 1 Jan: the birthday has happened, so the age ticks over that day.
New Year's Eve of the same season: the group is unchanged from 1 Jan, the age is one lower.
Leap day, on 28 Feb of a non-leap year: the birthday has not happened yet.
Leap day, on 1 Mar of a non-leap year: the birthday has passed.
Leap day across the season boundary.
Quarter-boundary first: 1 Apr, on the season boundary.
Quarter-boundary first: 1 Jul, on the last day of the season.
Quarter-boundary first: 1 Oct, before the birthday.
Quarter-boundary first: 1 Oct, on the birthday, inside the rolled season year.
Last day of the calendar year: the season year is already the next one.
Born on 1 Aug, evaluated on 31 Jul: neither the season nor the birthday has turned over.
Born 31 Jul, evaluated 1 Aug: both have turned over.
Youngest group in range: U5 is still a label.
Below the clamp: U3 is not a label. The age is still a real answer.
Above the clamp: an adult DOB has no U-group, and must not render as U37.
